page_title: PAU 0-1 EIN | St. Pauli v Eintracht Frankfurt 11/01/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' Nothing more will happen in this game as the referee blows for full time.
90+6' Manolis Saliakas (St. Pauli) serves up a nice cross, but the defence clears the danger.
90+5' Rasmus Kristensen (Eintracht Frankfurt) shouldn't be surprised it's a yellow from the ref, who cooled the situation down well.
90+5' 41:59 – the latest ball possession ratio.
90' We will have 6 min. of added time.
86' Substitution. David Nemeth did his best and is replaced by Andreas Nielsen Albers (St. Pauli).
86' Dino Toppmoller has decided to substitute Omar Marmoush and he is replaced by Igor Matanovic (Eintracht Frankfurt).
84' The ball is cleared after Noah Weisshaupt (St. Pauli) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
84' Scott Banks (St. Pauli) latches on to a nice cross and directs a header at goal. Unfortunately for him, the ball only hits the right post.
83' Substitution. Nathaniel Brown walks off the pitch and Tuta (Eintracht Frankfurt) comes on as a substitute.
78' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and James Sands (St. Pauli) will replace Carlo Boukhalfa.
78' Here is a change. Danel Sinani is going off and Alexander Blessin gives the last tactical orders to Scott Banks (St. Pauli).
75' Morgan Guilavogui (St. Pauli) is adjudged to have been offside when making his run.
75' Noah Weisshaupt (St. Pauli) delivers a fine lofted cross into the penalty area, but it's cleared by an opposing player.
72' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Oscar Hojlund (Eintracht Frankfurt) is coming onto the pitch as Hugo Ekitike cannot continue after picking up an injury.
72' Dino Toppmoller has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Ansgar Knauff (Eintracht Frankfurt) replacing Mario Gotze.
72' The shots on goal statistics – 4:6.
71' St. Pauli are bossing possession at the moment by exchanging some precise passes from player to player.
68' Substitution. Oladapo Afolayan leaves the pitch and is replaced by Noah Weisshaupt (St. Pauli).
66' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Eintracht Frankfurt comes to nothing.

64' A loose pass is instantly latched onto by Rasmus Kristensen (Eintracht Frankfurt). He tries his luck from the edge of the box with a measured shot, but it hits the right post and is cleared to safety.
64' Neat passing move from St. Pauli in order to create new attacking opportunities.
61' Nnamdi Collins (Eintracht Frankfurt) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Harm Osmers had an easy-decision to make.
59' St. Pauli control the tempo of the game by exchanging some accurate short passes.
59' Mario Gotze (Eintracht Frankfurt) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence quickly intercepts the ball.

57' Carlo Boukhalfa (St. Pauli) trips an opponent with a slide tackle. Harm Osmers stops the game and he could give him a card, but eventually decides on just a warning. Eintracht Frankfurt are awarded a free kick. Let's see what they create from this.
57' St. Pauli players are playing combination football and attempting to create a goal-scoring opportunity, but they will have to wait for that as they have just lost possession due to a poor pass.
55' Jackson Irvine (St. Pauli) is well placed to meet a cross and sends a difficult header towards the middle of the goal, but the goalkeeper reacts well to stop the effort.
51' St. Pauli have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.

51' Manolis Saliakas (St. Pauli) has a sight of goal, fires a shot in from distance towards the bottom right corner and forces a good save out of Kevin Trapp. St. Pauli force their opponents to concede a corner.
49' Eintracht Frankfurt are showcasing great team work and neat passing moves.
47' The Eintracht Frankfurt players are exchanging some short passes.
46' The game restarts for the second half.
45+3' Harm Osmers has ended the first half by blowing the whistle.
45+2' St. Pauli take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
45+2' Morgan Guilavogui (St. Pauli) controls a pass, goes past a defender and curls a shot from the edge of the box right onto the right post.
45+1' A neat pass is well received by Omar Marmoush (Eintracht Frankfurt), who is lurking on the edge of the box and strikes the ball on goal. The goalkeeper makes a decent save to block his shot.
45' 2 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
40' St. Pauli enjoy a period of possession as they are exchanging some passes and waiting for an opportunity to strike.
38' Manolis Saliakas (St. Pauli) takes the corner and sends it into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence is ready and makes a good clearance.
34' Arthur Theate (Eintracht Frankfurt) gives away a foul for a clumsy challenge. Referee Harm Osmers saw the whole situation. That's a free kick to St. Pauli.
32' 0 - 1 Omar Marmoush (Eintracht Frankfurt) produces a moment of pure magic and scores a spectacular goal by striking the ball into the top left corner of the net!
26' Robin Koch (Eintracht Frankfurt) sees a yellow card. He should be more careful because one more challenge like that could result in a red card.

23' Morgan Guilavogui (St. Pauli) receives a well-played pass inside the penalty area and shoots. He sends the ball into orbit. The ball goes out of play and Eintracht Frankfurt will have a goal kick.
20' The assistant referee raises his flag and the referee blows his whistle. Hugo Ekitike (Eintracht Frankfurt) puts the ball into the net, but he is flagged for offside.
18' The Eintracht Frankfurt players are exchanging some short passes to try and open up the opposition’s defence and hit them swiftly on the break.

16' The whipped in corner perfectly picks out Rasmus Kristensen (Eintracht Frankfurt) near the penalty spot, but the ball comes off the top of his head and goes a mile over the bar. The ball goes out of play and St. Pauli will have a goal kick.
16' The ball goes out of play and Eintracht Frankfurt have been awarded a corner kick.
15' Eintracht Frankfurt are enjoying possession, but one of the opposition players steps in to end the sequence.
10' Great teamplay by Eintracht Frankfurt as they control the ball with a lot of short passes. Patience is the key if they want to find a gap in the defence to score.

6' Ellyes Skhiri (Eintracht Frankfurt) runs onto a good long pass and tries his luck from the edge of the box, but his effort flies high over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for St. Pauli.
4' Eintracht Frankfurt can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.

4' Omar Marmoush (Eintracht Frankfurt) latches on to an accurate pass on the edge of the box and unleashes a strong shot towards the right side of the goal, but his effort is denied by the well positioned keeper with a stunning save. The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Eintracht Frankfurt.
2' Eintracht Frankfurt are playing excellent possession football at the moment by exchanging some long passes.
1' The referee blows his whistle and we are underway.
The players are on the pitch and St. Pauli will have the kick-off.
Harm Osmers will officiate today.
